Name: SVE Fox Victor Portrait and Sprites - Furry
Author: tarruvi
Description:
I created this mod after stumbling upon SVE - Stardew Valley Extended.
And, was eager to add some compatible sprites to my anthro riddled game.

In conclusion, I was not satisfied with how Vincent looked in some of the compatibility anthro mods.
But, the other characters in said mods were alright to amazing.
I use all the other sprites within them, but not Victor's.

So, we come to this point.
I created an anthro fox Victor, just to break the feline bachelor/bachelorette combos going on.
But, also to "freshen" up the game with a new face.

Downloads.Description: Alters SVE's Victor portraits/sprites to this Anthro version.
